annotations.title: List my Zero to Hundred listings

description: Find the authenticated Builder's drafts and live listings before creating another draft. Requires listings:read. Returns items with slugs, publication state, USD prices, edit links, and nextCursor. Pass nextCursor to continue paging; null ends the list. An invalid or expired token requires sign-in again.

cursor.description: Continue after the last listing in the preceding result. Use that response's nextCursor; omission starts at the newest listing.

limit.description: Number of owned listings to return per page. Omission uses 25, with newest listings first.

setupCode.description: Temporary code from the Zero to Hundred connection check. Omit for ordinary listing reads.

name: z2h_list_my_listings

items.description: The authenticated Builder's listings, newest first.

askingPrice.description: USD license price, or null when unset.

editUrl.description: Web wizard URL for editing this listing.

operatingStatus.description: Operating state of the software, independent of listing publication.

publishUrl.description: Web review step where the Builder finishes publishing.

slug.description: Listing identifier used by the other Builder tools.

status.description: Listing publication state. Only drafts can be edited through MCP.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null at the end.

title: List my Zero to Hundred listings
